title: The Next Step in AFM-Based Vibrational Optical Nanospectroscopy
content: Here, we introduce the next generation nano-IR product based on Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM), which integrates cutting-edge nano-optical technologies including AFM-IR and s-SNOM (scattering-type Scanning Near-field Optical Microscopy) and Raman for both imaging and spectroscopy at the nanoscale. The system allows for high-resolution, multimodal characterization of materials and biological specimens, surpassing the limitations of traditional imaging techniques. This platform combines the precision of AFM with the chemical specificity provided by vibrational spectroscopy with nano-IR and Raman spectroscopy, enabling users to obtain a comprehensive understanding of their samples. This multimodal approach provides crucial insights into surface morphology, chemical composition, and optical properties all in one system, streamlining complex surface analysis workflows.
